summary: Hengaw reported that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) shot dead Shayan Zarei, a 23-year-old Kurdish man of the Yarsan faith, near Kuzeran on the outskirts of Kirmaşan on the evening of 13 November, opening fire without warning while he was travelling with two other people; he died at the scene. The condition and whereabouts of his two companions were unknown. Hengaw added that Zarei had been prosecuted years earlier over a group fight that ended in a death and had been released on bail.

sources.title: Hengaw: IRGC kills Kurdish Yarsani man Shayan Zarei in Kuzaran

summary: Hengaw, Kurdpa and KHRN reported that Iranian border guards shot dead Tayeb Rostami, a 34-year-old kolbar from Bane, at close range and without warning in the Surkêw border area in the early hours of 14 November; Kurdpa said he was hit by two rounds in the head and abdomen. He was married with one child and his wife is pregnant. KHRN said at least eight kolbars have been shot dead by Iranian border guards in Kurdistan this year.
